rows.name: a track goes back to the start at the end of its file, as it did before #94, so it never ends
after the end, the rest of the buffer keeps whatever it held before, instead of silence
a track that has ended never finishes: the music thread waits for ever, and the next track is never picked
a track finishes before all of it has been heard, as soon as one buffer is back
a track that has finished still says it's playing, so the game never picks the next
a file that ends before any audio comes out of it is taken for a track that has ended, not refused
the audio that comes out of a file isn't noted, so every end of a file is taken for a file with none
track numbers aren't counted from 1, so track 1 plays the second name in the list
with no tracks found, asking for track 0 reads TrackList[0] of an empty list, as it did before (this one crashes)
